notes.title: MEMEBAWX CRATE RELEASE 8/10/2024
notes.content:
LOOTBAWXERS!! Big release today 8/10/24.

CRATE UPDATES:
- MEMEBAWX HAS LANDED. Update right now during todays event to get a free memebawx.
- Memebawxes are added to main rotation. This means every 1.5 hours (or 45min for 2x speed) you have a 33% chance to get a memebawx, crawly gnome bawx, or clickerbawx.
- DISCORDBAWX HAS BEEN FIXED. All users have been reset and are eligible to get another discord bawx. When you login you will receive it as long as you are still on discord.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE 8/5/24
notes.content:
Hello lootbawxers! We added

- No more disruption on server update. This means you still get crates overnight! Update your game client at your convenience!
- Added a CLICKER LOOT BAWX full of items from your favorite clicker games
- Added a REVOLVER LOOT BAWX. This will be used in the upcoming wager mode where players will face off in a Russian Roulette game.

- Clicker loot bawx will drop every hour alongside the crawly gnome bawx.
- Revolver is a one time drop for now -- you get what you get. There will be future opportunities for different guns.
